text: No deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis found no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. While small patches of loss (0.4 ha in 2021) were detected, these were below the minimum event threshold and not counted as deforestation. The asset had no forest cover in 2020 (0.0 ha), and all prior loss events (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020) occurred before the baseline. The data covers the entire asset with high observability (100% valid data).
